investigation_notes.Description: Anomalously large (953 bytes) and high-entropy DNS A queries from host-812-workstation to contentdelivery.net were observed, with encoded-looking subdomain labels consistent with DNS tunneling. The destination IP shows an abuse score of 0 but is registered to Ford Motor Company which does not align with the contentdelivery.net naming, and no recent similar alerts were found. Because of the unusually large payload, high-entropy query labels, and the domain/IP mismatch, this activity is considered a high-risk indicator that warrants escalation.
